ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) covering approximately 65-70% of the fluke area, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels on the margins and central regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white contiguous zones occupy the outer lateral lobes. A low-intensity black region is centrally localized, extending from the base toward the median notch. Mid-intensity brownish/yellowish spots are distributed across the white lateral zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; jagged peaks are most pronounced at the lateral tips, transitioning to lower-amplitude variations toward the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward concave sweep terminating in pointed lateral apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-contrast white circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) at the lateral tips; small white circular spots on the dark central pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, near-vertical linear streaks present on the lower interior quadrant of the left white fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle clusters attached to both lateral tips; visible brownish-yellow surface staining across the white ventral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive brownish focal staining clusters located on the mid-upper regions of both white lateral lobes.
